dispositions.rationale: The final truncating rewrite is removed. Completed and skipped rows use the same append-only TrialStream, so finalization no longer destroys accumulated records before summary generation. Cancellation checks the stream's identity and readable bytes, reports complete records and any partial tail, and compares the acknowledged byte prefix instead of unconditionally asserting retention. Missing or replaced streams do not receive a successful retention claim. The new regressions exercise real main/_run_experiment orchestration with controlled producers and cover finalization interruption, a partial sixth append, missing-stream reporting and skipped rows. KeyboardInterrupt still unwinds the campaign and reaches exit 130.

dispositions.rationale: Timeout coverage now reads the retained process receipt and requires a positive integer PID, an observed timeout, a matching reaped exit, matching TIMEOUT reasons without interruption, verified cleanup with no remaining owned PIDs, and a confirmed receipt. An unexercised trial stops further dispatch and prevents COMPLETE. Stable transport facts participate in reproducibility, while the separate private receipt hash is excluded from that projection. Regressions cover EAGAIN through the real synthetic transport boundary in both arms, missing prerequisites, a real short-lived timeout positive, and changed timeout/error facts.
